preview.overview: The Cougars have the edge in the all-time series at 3-2, including a 34-28 victory the last time these teams met in 2024, making this a chance for BYU to reclaim the belt on their home field.
key_matchups: Baylor's offensive consistency against BYU's recent defensive improvements; the Bears scored 42, 41, and 55 points in three of their last five games while BYU held Iowa State to 10 points
BYU's home-field advantage and recent form against ranked competition, having beaten Notre Dame 28-24 and Arizona State 27-20
The Cougars' ability to execute in close games, as evidenced by their 28-24 win over Notre Dame and 24-10 victory over Iowa State
preview.betting_angles: BYU has won the head-to-head matchup in the most recent meeting (34-28 in 2024) and holds a 3-2 series advantage all-time. Baylor has shown defensive vulnerabilities, allowing 31 to Iowa State and 25 to Kansas in recent outings, while BYU has demonstrated the ability to win close contests and hold opponents to low scores. The Cougars' home-field performance and recent victories over quality opponents suggest they match up favorably with the belt-holding Bears.
preview.prediction_writeup: BYU enters this matchup with momentum and the all-time series advantage at 3-2, including last year's 34-28 win that showed the Cougars can execute down the stretch. Baylor's recent form includes two losses (24-25 at Kansas and 6-17 vs TCU) that expose defensive inconsistency, while BYU has strung together convincing wins over Notre Dame and Arizona State. The Cougars' ability to win close games and their home-field advantage in Provo make them slight favorites to capture the belt. Expect another tight contest given the teams' recent history, but BYU's recent confidence and experience in this rivalry give them the edge to reclaim the championship.
